services.desc: Contrary to what one might expect, Central Utah's desert landscapes offer some of the state's most impressive fishing. From the Fremont River to the Fish Lake Plateau, anglers find numerous spots to catch trophy fish. Below is a list of top fishing locations near Fremont, Utah. Though small, this river holds monster trout. Due to its remote location and prolific insect hatches, the Fremont river holds a large quantity of quality fish in its lower stretches. Starting at Johnson Valley Reservoir, the Fremont River flows into Mill Meadow Reservoir before flowing down through Fremont and over to Torrey.
